## Evidence (never tick without observed results)
- [ ] Original failure and regression verified
- [ ] Counterexamples, negative/unknown cases checked (semantic work: paraphrases, near-neighbours, negation and unseen case)
- [ ] Relevant automated tests executed, including CI discovery
- [ ] Required real-dependency/integration/E2E checks executed, or explicitly marked pending below
- [ ] Diff reviewed for hardcoding, weakened tests and unapproved scope changes
- [ ] Affected docs/handoff reconciled with actual evidence

| Check | SHA / environment / command | Result PASS / FAIL / NOT RUN / BLOCKED | Evidence URL / detail |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Unit / build | | NOT RUN | |
| Integration / live / browser (as applicable) | | NOT RUN | |
| Real outcome / adversarial cases | | NOT RUN | |
| Independent review | | REVIEW PENDING | |

## Open gates and release decision
- Remaining failures or unverified claims:
- Reviewer / independent acceptance evidence, or **REVIEW PENDING**:
- Release status: DRAFT / REVIEW PENDING / ACCEPTED (with evidence):
- Production, external action and merge approvals (if applicable):
- Next bounded action:

A green build, author's own tests or a completed checklist do not certify the product. Do not mark acceptance or promote a high-impact change with P0 behavioural checks pending.
